targets.name: Composio
targets.workflow: Expose a small set of public financial-research actions through Composio so developers can use them in existing agents, with the three product scopes kept separate.
targets.data_opportunity: Start with a dated Seiche funding-context action and source-status action. Add covered-institution lookup and indicative BTC research only after separate output and rights review. Ask for one developer evaluator to complete and repeat the funding task.
targets.next_action: Composio partner review and technical/auth schema qualification; public no-key product access does not eliminate Composio account requirements. Retention, caching and downstream display scope must be agreed.

targets.name: Domo
targets.workflow: A small Seiche reference-FX connector is a concrete entry to governed research dashboards; bank evidence can initially be a linked workflow rather than copied filings.
targets.data_opportunity: Map the previously qualified four ECB EUR reference series (USD/GBP/JPY/INR) and date/source/units fields into a sample Domo dataset. Keep revised vintages visible and include attribution/free-source notices. Evaluate one daily reference-rate research card.
targets.next_action: Data/technology intake, native connector test and review, attribution and redistribution scope, refresh expectations. Do not select reseller/OEM arrangements or claim unrestricted rights to the whole family.

targets.name: Hex
targets.workflow: A reusable research notebook can place source-linked Seiche observations next to a covered-institution evidence review, preserving each product's meaning.
targets.data_opportunity: A notebook that fetches a public funding-context record, displays native units and source dates, and lets an analyst open the primary source. Offer a second independent institution-review page only if requested. No combined score or forecast.
targets.next_action: Confirm whether Hex wants an integration, template or consulting route. A template/demo should precede any partner-tier or referral commitment. Workspace access and publication permissions required for native testing.

targets.name: Vellum
targets.workflow: A small Seiche or Undertow research plugin can deliver a reproducible task through the existing remote MCP surface.
targets.data_opportunity: Package one read-only Seiche funding task with source/date/refusal instructions, then test on an actual Vellum assistant before asking support to route directory review.
targets.next_action: Actual Vellum runtime QA and whitelist review. Start a server with no more than20tools; the known24-tool LiquiLens surface exceeds that cap and must not be described as fully available. Never embed credentials.

targets.name: Agno
targets.workflow: A maintained funding-evidence example meets a concrete finance-agent task and is easier to evaluate than a broad family listing.
targets.data_opportunity: An Agent using one public Seiche MCP endpoint answers a funding-context question with source timestamps and explicit missingness. Keep a human check of source citations and model-selected tools.
targets.next_action: Current contribution/style requirements, dependency pin, real SDK run plus TEST_LOG and maintainer acceptance. Framework compatibility is not a corporate partnership.

targets.name: Paragon
targets.workflow: Financial research application builders might benefit from a source-preserving read-only connector or action that supplies evidence cards to their existing product.
targets.data_opportunity: Qualify demand for one institution-evidence action from an existing research-application builder before implementing a generic connector. Ask whether unauthenticated public APIs are supported in the partner catalog flow.
targets.next_action: This is a sales/contact route, not an open free marketplace submission. No-key API support, catalog admission, commercial terms and evaluator demand remain unqualified. Prioritize after Composio/Agno.
